data.title: 春日野穹 · 卧室玄关黑白连衣裙拉链卡壳事故 ·「悠快过来……穹的裙子脱不掉了……好难受」
data.description: 【穹的卧室玄关·闷热午后】出汗后粘在身上的黑白哥特萝莉裙拉链卡死在背脊。穹双手反剪在身后撑在榻榻米矮柜上，纤弱的脊骨弯成诱人的弧度，裙摆被死死卡在腰间，露出穿黑色吊带长袜的白嫩臀瓣与开档内裤。她咬着下唇回头，眼角泪花闪烁——「悠……快帮穹解开……好热……再不脱掉穹要死掉了……」
data.location: 穹的卧室玄关·闷热午后
data.action: 撑矮柜塌腰回眸双手反剪扯拉链，黑白萝莉裙卡腰露白臀黑丝，咬唇垂泪求助
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano leans forward over a low wooden chest in her humid summer bedroom, her black-and-white Gothic dress snagged at the delicate rear zipper. Her frail, pale spine arches beneath the strain, the hem pulled taut across her smooth bottom to showcase black thigh-high stockings secured by lace garters. Turning her head back with silver bangs falling into teary gray eyes, she bites her trembling lip in helpless frustration, whining for her brother’s gentle touch. Cinematic horizontal composition, golden afternoon sunlight pouring through bamboo blinds onto pale curves, detailed background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
